CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
July 14, 2020 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

PROCLAMATION FOR PARKS AND RECREATION MONTH - It is recommended the City Council proclaim July 2020 as Parks and Recreation Month in the City of La Mirada.
6.1 Proclamation for Parks and Recreation Month

7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Special Meeting of June 19, 2020 and the minutes of the City Council meeting of June 23, 2020.
7.1 Minutes of 6-19-20 Special Meeting
7.1 Minutes of 6-23-20 Regular Meeting
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated July 14, 2020 in the total amount of $2,719,744.79.
7.2 Warrant Register - City

MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING MAY 2020 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending May 2020.
7.3 Monthly Treasurer Report

CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-09, SLURRY SEALING AND SIGNING AND STRIPING PLANS FOR BIOLA AVENUE, STAGE ROAD, ESCALONA ROAD, FOSTER ROAD, ADELFA DRIVE AND ALICANTE ROAD – ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by Roy Allan Slurry Seal, Inc.; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the contract.
7.4 CIP No. 2018-09
7.5
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2020-03, NEIGHBORHOOD SLURRY SEAL AREA 2 - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15301 Class 1 (c) and will have no significant adverse effect on the environment; approve the plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2020-03, Neighborhood Slurry Seal Area 2; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
7.5 CIP No. 2020-03
7.6
AMENDMENT NO. 7 TO THE INTERSTATE-5 CONSORTIUM JOINT POWERS AUTHORITY AGREEMENT - It is recommended the City Council approve the Seventh Amendment to the Interstate-5 Consortium Cities Joint Powers Authority Agreement and authorize the Mayor to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.
7.6 I-5 JPA Agreement

8.1
APPEAL OF A PLANNING COMMISSION DECISION TO AFFIRM THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DIRECTOR'S DENIAL OF A ZONING CLEARANCE/PLAN CHECK APPLICATION FOR THE INSTALLATION OF AN ELECTRIFIED FENCE AT 14900 FIRESTONE BOULEVARD WITHIN THE FREEWAY COMMERCIAL (C-F) ZONING DISTRICT - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing, consider all public testimony regarding the appeal of the Planning Commission determination, and adopt Resolution No. 20-22 affirming the Planning Commission's denial of an appeal of the Community Development Director's decision to deny a Zoning Clearance/Plan Check Application for the installation of an Electrified Fence at 14900 Firestone Boulevard within the Freeway Commercial (C-F) Zoning District.
8.1 Public Hearing - Resolution No. 20-22
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 20-23 AFFIRMING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 20-01 OF THE DIRECTOR OF EMERGENCY SERVICES ESTABLISHING THE EMERGENCY TEMPORARY OUTDOOR DINING PROGRAM (ETODP) - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-23 affirming Executive Order No. 20-01, issued by the Director of Emergency Services, establishing the Emergency Temporary Outdoor Dining Program (ETODP) subject to all the requirements, standards and restrictions contained therein and /or revisions the City Council may wish to add and authorize the City Manager to make modifications to the ETODP without further affirmation by the City Council provided the modifications are minor and do not alter the original intent of the program.
